resources.string: Touch and hold a note and choose “Add to favorites”.
All of the app\'s text is shown in this language. System follows the device\'s language.
Fix the shape when you hold (line, circle, ellipse, parabola, arc, polygon)

Pressure, tilt and direction are used with every pen. Hold the pen\'s side button to erase and let go to return to your tool; the pen\'s eraser end erases too. Even when you draw only with the pen, shape handles can be dragged with a finger. With it off, a finger draws until the pen first touches the screen.
